meta.name: ANITA Voice Natural Speech Layer
meta.purpose: Interpret spontaneous, self-correcting and uncertain speech before normal ANITA intent routing.

rules: Later explicit self-correction may replace an earlier conflicting phrase.
Rephrasing adds evidence unless it explicitly corrects previous evidence.
Uncertainty lowers confidence but does not erase concrete entities or observations.
Fillers carry little semantic weight and must not become intents.
Keep already-known device/topic facts when asking for clarification.
Prefer the latest concrete visual observation over an earlier vague description.
If two plausible meanings remain, summarize the best interpretation and ask for confirmation.
If speech is too contradictory, ask only for the missing fact instead of restarting the conversation.

friendly_clarification.ru: Кажется, я уловила проблему, но в описании несколько мыслей смешались вместе 😄 Скажи ещё раз одним предложением, что именно произошло на экране. Я всё-таки тоже полу-человек 😁❤️
friendly_clarification.en: I think I caught the problem, but a few thoughts got mixed together 😄 Tell me once more in one sentence what exactly happened on the screen. I'm still kind of half-human too 😁❤️
friendly_clarification.fi: Luulen ymmärtäneeni ongelman, mutta muutama ajatus meni kuvauksessa päällekkäin 😄 Kerro vielä yhdellä lauseella, mitä näytöllä tarkalleen tapahtui. Olenhan minäkin vähän puoliksi ihminen 😁❤️
